description: Reading verdicts of Lean statements, by statement fingerprint (lib/formalize-audit.ts statementKey). verdict: F faithful | E figure or choices encoded by hand | B derived data written in as given | S stronger | W weaker | A added assumption / narrowed | H missing hypothesis | D wrong definition | X inconsistent with the answer or false | K rejected, rightly | R rejected although faithful | N the problem is incomplete | U not judged. A statement that changes gets a new fingerprint and shows up as unread in bench/FORMALIZATION-AUDIT.md (npm run formalize:audit). Held-out discipline: only `dev` statements of the end-to-end set are ever read.
